Part 2B - Currency Information
2B.1 Does the entity default to payment in certain currencies dependent upon certain attributes such as the
banking instruction or registered address of the +securityholder? (For example NZD to residents of New Zealand
and/or USD to residents of the U.S.A.).
2B.2 Please provide a description of your currency arrangements
Shareholders will have their dividend paid in:
- Australian dollars if they have nominated an Australian bank for direct credit; or
- New Zealand dollars if they have nominated a New Zealand bank for direct credit.
In the absence of a banking instruction, their payment will be:
- Withheld in Australian dollars for Australian and Overseas (excluding New Zealand) registered shareholders;
- Withheld in New Zealand dollars for New Zealand registered shareholders.
The conversation rate for payments made in New Zealand dollars will be set at the Reserve Bank of Australia foreign
exchange rate at the close of business on 18 August 2026.

4A.11 Are there any other conditions applying to DRP participation?
4A.11a Conditions for DRP participation
Participation in the DRP is restricted to shareholders who are resident in, and whose address on the Register of
Shareholders is in, Australia and New Zealand, Hong Kong and the United Kingdom.
